name: Space weather
summary: NOAA scales at G0 S0 R0 in the 24 hours to 25 Nov; forecast peaks at a minor G1
state: NOAA's space weather scales showed no geomagnetic storm, radiation storm or radio blackout in the 24 hours to 05:40 UTC on 25 Nov, and the forecast peaks at a minor G1 storm, inside the Normal band (NOAA SWPC).
for_you: No effect on power, satellites or radio is expected. Aurora may be visible at high latitudes during minor storms.

sources.title: NOAA SWPC — Space Weather Prediction Center

why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
